title: 小鹏顾宏地：欧洲试驾反响热烈，Robotaxi合作模式揭秘
speaker: Brian Gu

segments.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year. You're also bringing this technology to Europe, VLA 2.0 next year. How do you see the response from regulators, your customers in Europe, are they embracing this sort of technology?
segments.zh: 所以这些都是相互关联的。我认为，可能要到明年第二季度左右，我们推出这种商业模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。你们明年也会把这项技术带到欧洲，VLA 2.0。您如何看待监管机构和欧洲客户的反应，他们是否接受这类技术？

segments.en: Or do you think there are a bit of cautious still when it comes to Chinese technology like this?
segments.zh: 或者您认为，面对这类中国技术，他们是否仍有些谨慎？

segments.en: Well, I would say Europe is certainly at the earliest stage of the adoption curve for ADAS for high-end ADAS functions.
segments.zh: 我想说，欧洲在高级ADAS功能的采用曲线上确实处于最早阶段。

segments.en: But actually what I would be very interested is that we just launched our custom test drive in Paris for our NGP, which is the autonomous driving technology.
segments.zh: 但真正让我感兴趣的是，我们刚在巴黎为NGP推出了定制试驾，这是我们的自动驾驶技术。

segments.en: So far the response has been great. And I think we actually had a much better reception to consumers for this technology.
segments.zh: 到目前为止反响很好。我认为消费者对这项技术的接受度实际上要高得多。

segments.en: I think actually it is, I would say, something that requires custom education requires a lot of investment in really developing the business model, as I mentioned earlier.
segments.zh: 我认为这确实需要定制化的教育，需要大量投入来真正开发商业模式，正如我之前提到的。

segments.en: But I think the potential is huge. And if you see the penetration FSD has in certain European market and also in Australia, I think there's a lot of promises for this technology.
segments.zh: 但我认为潜力巨大。如果你看看FSD在某些欧洲市场和澳大利亚的渗透率，这项技术的前景非常可观。

segments.en: You're also well in terms of robotaxies, you're not planning to run your robotaxie fleet yourself.
segments.zh: 在Robotaxi方面，你们也不打算自己运营车队。

segments.en: So can you tell us a bit more about who your partners are going to be and how are you going to get paid?
segments.zh: 那么能否多谈谈你们的合作伙伴会是谁，以及你们将如何获得收入？

segments.en: Well, I think the traditional robotaxie business, you can see it from, you know, there's a few players that's involved. One is a technology provider, the other one is the vehicle provider, and the other one is a mobility operator.
segments.zh: 我认为传统的Robotaxi业务，可以看到有几个参与者：一个是技术提供商，另一个是车辆提供商，还有一个是出行运营商。

segments.en: For us, we actually combine the technology and vehicle into one. So we actually become a much easier partner for a lot of the mobility operators around the world.
segments.zh: 对我们而言，我们实际上将技术和车辆合二为一。因此我们成为全球许多出行运营商更容易合作的伙伴。

segments.en: So I think for us is that we will be, you know, entering into interesting partnerships in select metropolitan cities around the world where robotaxie we think generate lots value and demand.
segments.zh: 所以我认为对我们来说，我们将在全球选定的主要城市建立有趣的合作伙伴关系，我们认为Robotaxi在那里能产生大量价值和需求。

segments.en: And we will be the full stack solution and vehicle provider, where our partner provides the mobility services and operations.
segments.zh: 我们将成为全栈解决方案和车辆提供商，而我们的合作伙伴提供出行服务和运营。

segments.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg.
segments.zh: 我认为当我们真正准备好宣布这些协议时，我们会很乐意与彭博分享。
